stories.coverage: 24 controlled service-integration stories using production AIRI, context assembly, persistent work and DSH. Setup chat and worker decisions use local scripted responses; facts are reviewed through production transactions, day summaries are deterministic source quotes. Final answers and their tool steps use the saved real chat model; final retrieval uses real Voyage. This measures retrieval, injection, answer use and action compliance; it does not re-evaluate automatic fact extraction or replace the normal-product acceptance evidence.
